title: acosta limbata
intro: Acosta limbata, commonly known as the "Yellow Acosta" or "Tres Marías", is a plant species in the family Gentianaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and anxiety, and promoting relaxation. The health benefits of Acosta limbata are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gentiopicrin, swertiamarin, and other iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
